fields.System.Title: INB-206 — Escalate an over-receipt beyond tolerance
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want large over-deliveries to need my approval, so that we do not
silently accept and pay for stock we did not order.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a quantity above tolerance, then the line is held pending approval and the
  • receipt cannot be confirmed.
  • - Given approval, then the full quantity is accepted and the approver recorded.
  • - Given rejection, then only the expected quantity is received and the excess is
  • recorded as refused.
  • - Given the clerk who recorded it, then they cannot approve it themselves.
  • - Given the escalation, then the supervisor is notified rather than having to discover
  • it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, platform |
| Tables | receipt_line, discrepancy |
| Risks | Approval bypassed; truck held while nobody is notified |
| Tests | unit · integration |
